summary: Iteration 35: Validated all Iter35 features end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests PASSED (invoice MB-0025 floor & advance, public/settings & PUT settings usd_to_dop persistence, claim cover fields persistence, item category tagging, FMP merged PDF structure with cover + checklist + doc pages, status→complete on merge). Frontend: Claims edit modal shows/persists all 5 cover fields; item edit modal category dropdown lists 7 FMP options and saves; completed packets show green rows + Complete badge; Merge & Save PDF button present. Billing Reports EN shows $, ES shows RD$; CEO Clinic Letterhead lh-usd-dop saves and public/settings reflects new rate.

issues: RD$ values rendered without thousands separators or a space, e.g. 'RD$39000.00' instead of 'RD$ 39,000.00'. Minor readability issue for large amounts.
Hydration warning persists (from iter34): <span> inside <option> child in dynamic select (forms/invoices options wrap translated labels in <span>). Cosmetic — does not affect functionality.

action_items: (Optional polish) Format RD$ amounts with thousands separators and a space, e.g., 'RD$ 39,000.00'. Update the money() helper in /app/frontend/src/pages/BillingReports.js to use Intl.NumberFormat when lang==='es'.
(Cosmetic) Remove <span> wrappers inside <option> children (Claims.js line 251 area) to silence the React hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: claims.py _build_packet_pdf: cover-page invoice/CPT lookup uses the FIRST item with source='invoice'. If a packet has multiple invoice items, only the first one populates cover Invoice/Amount rows — consider summing amounts or iterating.

claims.py GET /claims/{cid}/merged unconditionally sets status='complete' before the StreamingResponse finishes. If the download aborts mid-stream the packet is still marked complete (already noted iter34).
billing.py _compute_next_number relies on distinct('invoice_number') and re-parses on every call — race prone under concurrent invoice creation. Consider a MongoDB counter document or unique index.
settings PUT uses full SettingsInput replacement; partial updates rely on client sending the entire settings body. usd_to_dop default handled correctly via schema.
